title: Doctors
description: Medical doctors (MD) and doctors of osteopathic medicine (DO) diagnose and treat illness and injury, prescribe medicine and perform procedures, as generalists or in a specialty.

title: Addiction medicine doctors
description: Doctors who treat addiction to alcohol, opioids and other drugs, including with medicines that help recovery.

title: Allergists
description: Allergists diagnose and treat allergies, asthma and problems of the immune system.

title: Anesthesiologists
description: Anesthesiologists keep patients safe and pain-free during surgery and procedures, and some treat chronic pain.

title: Rheumatologists
description: Rheumatologists treat arthritis and autoimmune diseases such as lupus that affect the joints, muscles and other organs.

title: Orthopedic doctors
synonyms: orthopedist;orthopedic surgeon;orthopaedic surgeon;orthopedic doctor;bone doctor;hand surgeon
description: Orthopedic doctors and surgeons treat injuries and diseases of the bones, joints, muscles and spine, including joint replacement.

title: Neurologists
description: Neurologists diagnose and treat diseases of the brain, spinal cord and nerves, such as stroke, epilepsy, migraine and Parkinson's.

title: Neurosurgeons
description: Neurosurgeons operate on the brain, spine and nerves, for example for tumors, injuries and back problems.

title: Cancer and blood specialists
description: Oncologists and hematologists treat cancer and blood diseases with chemotherapy, radiation, surgery and other therapies.

title: Pediatricians
description: Pediatricians care for babies, children and teenagers: checkups, vaccines and illness, or a pediatric specialty.

title: Gastroenterologists
description: Gastroenterologists treat the stomach, intestines, liver and pancreas, and perform colonoscopies and endoscopies.

title: ENT doctors
description: ENT doctors (otolaryngologists) treat the ears, nose, sinuses, throat and neck, medically and with surgery.

title: Emergency doctors
description: Emergency doctors treat urgent illness and injury, mostly in hospital emergency departments.

title: Ophthalmologists
description: Ophthalmologists are medical doctors who diagnose and treat eye diseases and perform eye surgery, such as for cataracts.

title: Family doctors
synonyms: family doctor;family physician;primary care doctor;primary care physician;general practitioner;gp
description: Family doctors provide everyday care for people of all ages: checkups, common illnesses, long-term conditions and referrals.

title: General surgeons
description: General surgeons operate on the abdomen, skin, breast and soft tissue, and treat injuries; some focus on trauma, transplants or the colon.

title: Medical geneticists
description: Medical geneticists diagnose and manage inherited conditions and explain genetic test results.

title: Heart and chest surgeons
description: Cardiothoracic surgeons operate on the heart, lungs and chest, for example bypass and valve surgery.

title: Cardiologists
description: Cardiologists diagnose and treat heart and blood vessel problems such as heart disease, heart failure and irregular heartbeats.

title: Endocrinologists
description: Endocrinologists treat diabetes, thyroid problems and other hormone disorders.

title: Palliative care doctors
description: Palliative care doctors relieve pain and other symptoms of serious illness and care for people near the end of life.

title: Hospitalists
description: Hospitalists care for patients while they are in the hospital, instead of their regular doctor.

title: Radiologists
description: Radiologists read X-rays, CT, MRI and ultrasound scans, and some treat conditions with image-guided procedures.

title: Infectious disease doctors
description: Infectious disease doctors treat complex or unusual infections, including HIV, and advise on preventing infection.

title: Critical care doctors
description: Critical care doctors look after the sickest patients in intensive care units.

title: Internists
description: Internists are doctors for adults: they prevent, diagnose and treat a wide range of illnesses, often as primary care doctors.

title: Nephrologists
description: Nephrologists treat kidney disease and high blood pressure, and manage dialysis and kidney transplants.

title: Pathologists
description: Pathologists diagnose disease by examining tissue, blood and other samples in the laboratory.

title: Pulmonologists
description: Pulmonologists treat lung and breathing problems such as asthma, COPD and sleep apnea.

title: Psychiatrists
description: Psychiatrists are medical doctors who diagnose and treat mental illness, with medicine and therapy.

title: Oral and maxillofacial surgeons (MD, DO)
description: Oral and maxillofacial surgeons operate on the mouth, jaws and face, from wisdom teeth to jaw reconstruction.

title: Pain medicine doctors
description: Pain medicine doctors diagnose and treat long-lasting pain, often with injections, nerve procedures and medicines.

title: Plastic surgeons
description: Plastic surgeons reconstruct the body after injury, illness or birth defects, and perform cosmetic surgery.

title: Preventive medicine doctors
description: Preventive medicine doctors focus on keeping people healthy, including workplace health, public health and travel medicine.

title: Rehabilitation doctors
description: Rehabilitation doctors (physiatrists) help people recover function after injury, stroke or surgery, without operating.

title: Geriatricians
description: Geriatricians care for older adults, especially those with several health problems or many medicines.

title: Dermatologists
description: Dermatologists treat conditions of the skin, hair and nails, including skin cancer, acne and eczema.

title: Sleep medicine doctors
description: Sleep medicine doctors diagnose and treat sleep disorders such as sleep apnea and insomnia.

title: Sports medicine doctors
description: Sports medicine doctors treat sports and exercise injuries and help active people stay healthy.

title: Urologists
description: Urologists treat the kidneys, bladder and urinary tract, and the male reproductive organs, medically and with surgery.

title: Vascular specialists
description: Vascular specialists treat problems of the arteries and veins, such as blocked arteries, aneurysms and varicose veins.

title: Obesity medicine doctors
description: Obesity medicine doctors help people lose weight and treat weight-related conditions, with diet, medicines and referral for surgery.

title: OB/GYNs
description: OB/GYNs care for women's reproductive health, pregnancy and childbirth, and treat conditions of the female reproductive organs.

title: Other doctors
description: Doctors in other specialties, such as osteopathic manipulation, hyperbaric medicine and independent medical exams.

title: Nurse practitioners
description: Nurse practitioners are registered nurses with graduate training who examine patients, diagnose, prescribe and manage care, often in primary care.

title: Acute care nurse practitioners
description: Acute care nurse practitioners treat seriously ill patients, mostly in hospitals and intensive care units.

title: Adult and geriatric nurse practitioners
description: Adult-gerontology nurse practitioners provide primary or specialty care for adults and older adults.

title: Pediatric nurse practitioners
description: Pediatric and neonatal nurse practitioners care for children and newborns, from checkups to intensive care.

title: Family nurse practitioners
description: Family nurse practitioners provide everyday care for people of all ages: checkups, common illnesses and long-term conditions.

title: Psychiatric nurse practitioners
description: Psychiatric nurse practitioners diagnose and treat mental illness, including prescribing medicine.

title: Women's health nurse practitioners
description: Women's health nurse practitioners care for women's reproductive health, pregnancy and gynecologic conditions.

title: Nurse practitioners
description: Nurse practitioners who didn't list a focus, or work in occupational, school or community health.

title: Physician assistants
description: Physician assistants are licensed clinicians who examine, diagnose, treat and prescribe as part of a team with doctors.

title: Anesthesiologist assistants
description: Anesthesiologist assistants help give anesthesia, working under an anesthesiologist.

title: Medical physician assistants
description: Medical physician assistants work in primary care and medical specialties.

title: Surgical physician assistants
description: Surgical physician assistants assist in surgery and care for patients before and after operations.

title: Physician assistants
description: Physician assistants who didn't list a medical or surgical focus.

title: Nurses
description: Nurses care for patients, give medicines and treatments, watch for changes in their condition and teach patients and families.

title: Clinical nurse specialists
description: Clinical nurse specialists are nurses with graduate training in a specialty who care for patients and guide nursing practice.

title: Nurse anesthetists
description: Certified registered nurse anesthetists give anesthesia for surgery, procedures and childbirth.

title: Nursing assistants and psychiatric technicians
description: Nursing assistants and psychiatric technicians help patients with daily care under the direction of nurses.

title: Licensed practical and vocational nurses
description: Licensed practical and vocational nurses give basic nursing care under registered nurses or doctors.

title: Registered nurses
description: Registered nurses care for patients, give treatments and medicines and coordinate care, in many settings and specialties.

title: Midwives and doulas
description: Midwives care for women through pregnancy, birth and afterwards; doulas give non-medical support during pregnancy and birth.

title: Birth centers
description: Birth centers are places for low-risk births, usually run by midwives, outside a hospital.

title: Certified nurse midwives
description: Certified nurse midwives are advanced practice nurses who care for women in pregnancy, birth and gynecologic care.

title: Doulas
description: Doulas give emotional and practical support before, during and after birth; they don't give medical care.

title: Lactation consultants
description: Lactation consultants help mothers and babies with breastfeeding.

title: Midwives
description: Midwives care for women during pregnancy and birth, often at home or in birth centers.

title: Dentists
description: Dentists diagnose and treat problems of the teeth, gums and mouth, as general dentists or in a dental specialty.

title: Children's dentists
description: Pediatric dentists care for the teeth of babies, children and teenagers.

title: Prosthodontists
description: Prosthodontists restore and replace teeth with crowns, bridges, dentures and implants.

title: General dentists
description: General dentists provide checkups, cleanings, fillings, crowns and other everyday dental care.

title: Periodontists
description: Periodontists treat gum disease and place dental implants.

title: Oral surgeons
description: Oral surgeons remove teeth, including wisdom teeth, place implants and operate on the jaw and face.

title: Orthodontists
description: Orthodontists straighten teeth and correct the bite with braces and aligners.

title: Endodontists
description: Endodontists treat the inside of the tooth, mostly with root canal treatment.

title: Dental specialists
description: Dentists in other specialties, such as dental anesthesia, oral pathology, oral radiology and facial pain.

title: Dental hygienists and support
description: Dental hygienists, assistants, therapists, denturists and dental labs support dental care: cleanings, X-rays, dentures and dental appliances.

title: Dental assistants and therapists
description: Dental assistants help dentists during treatment; dental therapists provide some basic care themselves where states allow it.

title: Dental hygienists
description: Dental hygienists clean teeth, take X-rays and teach patients how to care for their teeth and gums.

title: Dental labs
description: Dental labs make crowns, bridges, dentures and other dental appliances.

title: Denturists
description: Denturists make and fit dentures directly for patients, where states allow it.

title: Mental health providers
description: Mental and behavioral health providers assess and treat emotional, behavioral and substance use problems with therapy, counseling and, for some, medicine.

title: Addiction counselors
description: Addiction counselors help people recover from alcohol and drug problems through counseling and support.

title: Addiction treatment centers
synonyms: rehab center;addiction treatment;methadone clinic;substance abuse treatment
description: Addiction treatment centers offer outpatient or residential programs for substance use, including methadone clinics.

title: Behavior analysts
description: Behavior analysts and technicians use applied behavior analysis (ABA), often with children with autism.

title: Counselors
description: Licensed counselors provide talk therapy for emotional, mental health and life problems.

title: Creative arts therapists
description: Art, music, dance and drama therapists use creative activities to help people express themselves and heal.

title: Marriage and family therapists
synonyms: marriage counselor;family therapist;couples therapist;marriage and family therapist
description: Marriage and family therapists treat relationship and family problems, with couples, families or individuals.

title: Mental health clinics and agencies
description: Mental health clinics and agencies provide therapy, psychiatric care and support services in the community.

title: Peer specialists
description: Peer specialists use their own recovery from mental illness or addiction to support others.

title: Psychiatric nurse practitioners
description: Psychiatric nurse practitioners diagnose and treat mental illness, including prescribing medicine.

title: Psychiatrists
description: Psychiatrists are medical doctors who diagnose and treat mental illness, with medicine and therapy.

title: Psychologists
description: Psychologists assess and treat mental health problems with testing and talk therapy; most don't prescribe medicine.

title: Residential treatment facilities
description: Residential treatment facilities give round-the-clock mental health care in a live-in setting.

title: Social workers
description: Clinical social workers provide therapy and help people with practical problems such as housing, benefits and family needs.

title: Other mental health providers
description: Other mental health providers, such as psychoanalysts and prevention specialists.

title: Therapy and rehabilitation providers
description: Therapists help people recover movement, strength, breathing and everyday skills after illness or injury, or with a lasting condition.

title: Athletic trainers
description: Athletic trainers prevent and treat sports injuries, often for schools and teams.

title: Exercise physiologists and kinesiotherapists
description: Exercise physiologists and kinesiotherapists design exercise programs for health conditions and recovery.

title: Occupational therapists
description: Occupational therapists help people do everyday activities, such as dressing, working and writing, after illness or injury.

title: Occupational therapy assistants
description: Occupational therapy assistants carry out treatment plans under an occupational therapist.

title: Physical therapists
description: Physical therapists help people move better and reduce pain with exercise, hands-on care and education.

title: Physical therapy assistants
description: Physical therapy assistants carry out treatment plans under a physical therapist.

title: Prosthetists and orthotists
description: Prosthetists and orthotists design and fit artificial limbs and braces.

title: Recreation and developmental therapists
description: Recreation and developmental therapists use activities and play to build skills and independence.

title: Rehabilitation and physical therapy clinics
description: Clinics that provide physical, occupational and other rehabilitation therapy.

title: Rehabilitation counselors and practitioners
description: Rehabilitation counselors and practitioners help people with disabilities live and work independently.

title: Respiratory therapists
description: Respiratory therapists treat breathing problems, manage ventilators and give breathing treatments.

title: Hearing and speech providers
description: Hearing and speech providers test and treat hearing loss and problems with speech, language and swallowing.

title: Audiologists
description: Audiologists test hearing and balance and fit hearing aids.

title: Hearing and speech centers
description: Centers that test and treat hearing, speech and communication problems.

title: Hearing aid specialists
description: Hearing aid specialists test hearing and fit and sell hearing aids.

title: Speech and audiology assistants
description: Assistants who support speech-language pathologists and audiologists.

title: Speech-language pathologists
description: Speech-language pathologists treat problems with speech, language, voice and swallowing.

title: Eye care providers
description: Eye care providers check vision, prescribe glasses and contact lenses and diagnose and treat eye diseases.

title: Eye banks
description: Eye banks collect and supply donated corneas for transplant.

title: Eye surgery centers
description: Outpatient centers for eye surgery, such as cataract surgery.

title: Eye technicians
description: Ophthalmic and optometric technicians help eye doctors with tests and patient care.

title: Ophthalmologists
description: Ophthalmologists are medical doctors who diagnose and treat eye diseases and perform eye surgery.

title: Opticians and eyewear
description: Opticians fit and sell glasses and contact lenses made to an eye doctor's prescription.

title: Optometrists
description: Optometrists (OD) examine eyes, prescribe glasses and contact lenses and treat many eye conditions.

title: Podiatrists
description: Podiatrists (DPM) diagnose and treat problems of the foot and ankle, including surgery.

title: Foot and ankle surgeons
description: Podiatric and orthopedic surgeons who operate on the foot and ankle.

title: Podiatric assistants
description: Assistants who help podiatrists with patient care.

title: Podiatrists
description: Podiatrists treat foot and ankle problems such as heel pain, bunions, diabetic foot care and injuries.

title: Podiatry clinics
description: Clinics that provide foot and ankle care.

title: Chiropractic and complementary care providers
description: Chiropractors and complementary care providers treat with hands-on methods, acupuncture, massage and natural therapies.

title: Acupuncturists
description: Acupuncturists treat pain and other conditions by placing thin needles at points on the body.

title: Chiropractors
description: Chiropractors diagnose and treat problems of the muscles, bones and joints, especially the back and neck, mostly with hands-on adjustments and exercise.

title: Homeopaths
description: Homeopaths treat with highly diluted natural remedies.

title: Massage therapists
description: Massage therapists use touch and pressure on muscles to relieve pain and tension.

title: Naturopaths
description: Naturopaths treat with nutrition, herbs and lifestyle changes; what they may do depends on the state.

title: Other complementary care providers
description: Reflexologists, naprapaths, health coaches and other complementary care providers.

title: Pharmacies
description: Pharmacies dispense prescription medicines and supplies, from retail stores to mail order, specialty and long-term care pharmacies.

title: Compounding pharmacies
description: Compounding pharmacies prepare medicines made to order for a patient, such as a different strength or form.

title: Government pharmacies
description: Pharmacies of the VA, the Indian Health Service and the military.

title: Home infusion pharmacies
description: Home infusion pharmacies prepare IV and injectable medicines given at home.

title: Long-term care pharmacies
description: Long-term care pharmacies supply medicines to nursing homes and assisted living facilities.

title: Mail order pharmacies
description: Mail order pharmacies send prescriptions by mail.

title: Retail pharmacies
description: Retail pharmacies are drugstores and other community pharmacies where people fill prescriptions.

title: Specialty pharmacies
description: Specialty pharmacies supply expensive or complex medicines, such as for cancer or multiple sclerosis, with extra support.

title: Pharmacies
description: Pharmacies that didn't list a type, and clinic, hospital and other pharmacies.

title: Pharmacists
description: Pharmacists check and dispense prescriptions, advise on medicines and their side effects, and in some settings manage drug therapy.

title: Pharmacists
description: Pharmacists check and dispense prescriptions, advise on medicines and, in some settings, manage drug therapy.

title: Pharmacy technicians
description: Pharmacy technicians prepare prescriptions under a pharmacist.

title: Dietitians and nutritionists
description: Dietitians and nutritionists assess diets and plan nutrition to manage health conditions or improve health.

title: Dietetic technicians and dietary managers
description: Dietetic technicians and dietary managers help plan and run food services and nutrition care.

title: Dietitians
description: Registered dietitians assess nutrition and plan diets to manage conditions such as diabetes, kidney disease and weight.

title: Nutritionists
description: Nutritionists give advice on food and healthy eating; training and licensing vary by state.

title: Hospitals
description: Hospitals provide inpatient care, surgery and emergency services; some specialize, such as children's, psychiatric and rehabilitation hospitals.

title: Children's hospitals
description: Hospitals for children and teenagers.

title: Critical access hospitals
description: Small rural hospitals, with 25 beds or fewer, that Medicare designates to keep care available in remote areas.

title: General hospitals
description: General hospitals provide emergency care, surgery and inpatient care for many conditions.

title: Hospital units
description: Separately registered units inside hospitals, such as psychiatric and rehabilitation units.

title: Long-term and specialty hospitals
description: Hospitals for patients who need hospital care for a long time, and other special hospitals.

title: Military hospitals
description: Hospitals of the armed forces.

title: Psychiatric hospitals
description: Hospitals that treat serious mental illness.

title: Rehabilitation hospitals
description: Hospitals for intensive rehabilitation after a stroke, injury or surgery.

title: Religious nonmedical institutions
description: Institutions that provide nonmedical nursing care to people who rely on religious healing.

title: Clinics and centers
description: Clinics and centers provide outpatient care: primary care, urgent care, surgery, imaging, dialysis and more.

title: Cancer centers
description: Outpatient centers for cancer treatment, including chemotherapy and radiation.

title: Dental clinics
description: Clinics that provide dental care.

title: Dialysis centers
description: Dialysis centers clean the blood of people whose kidneys have failed.

title: Family planning and fertility clinics
description: Clinics for birth control, family planning and fertility treatment.

title: Imaging centers
description: Outpatient centers for X-rays, MRI, CT, ultrasound and mammograms.

title: Military and VA clinics
description: Outpatient clinics of the VA and the armed forces.

title: Multi-specialty and specialty clinics
description: Clinics with doctors of one or several specialties.

title: Occupational health clinics
description: Clinics for workplace injuries, job physicals and employee health.

title: Primary care and community health centers
synonyms: community health center;fqhc;federally qualified health center;rural health clinic;primary care clinic
description: Primary care clinics, including community health centers that serve patients regardless of ability to pay.

title: Rehabilitation and physical therapy clinics
description: Clinics that provide physical, occupational and other rehabilitation therapy.

title: Sleep centers
description: Centers that test for and treat sleep disorders.

title: Surgery centers
description: Outpatient surgery centers, where patients go home the same day.

title: Urgent care and emergency centers
synonyms: urgent care;urgent care center;walk in clinic
description: Walk-in centers for illness and injury that need care the same day, and freestanding emergency rooms.

title: Nursing homes and senior living
description: Nursing homes and senior living facilities provide housing, personal care and nursing for people who can't live on their own.

title: Adult care homes
description: Adult care homes provide housing and help with daily activities, without skilled nursing.

title: Adult day care centers
description: Adult day care centers offer daytime care and activities for adults who need supervision.

title: Assisted living facilities
description: Assisted living facilities provide housing, meals and help with daily activities.

title: Memory care centers
description: Memory care centers care for people with Alzheimer's and other dementias.

title: Nursing homes
description: Nursing homes (skilled nursing facilities) provide round-the-clock nursing care and rehabilitation.

title: PACE programs
description: PACE programs provide all medical and long-term care for older adults so they can keep living at home.

title: Home care and hospice providers
description: Home care providers bring nursing, therapy and personal help to people at home; hospices care for people near the end of life.

title: Home health agencies
description: Home health agencies send nurses and therapists to care for people at home.

title: Home infusion agencies
description: Home infusion agencies give IV medicines and nutrition at home.

title: Home and vehicle modification contractors
description: Contractors who adapt homes and vehicles for people with disabilities.

title: Hospices
description: Hospices care for people near the end of life, at home or in a facility, with comfort care and family support.

title: Home-delivered meal providers
description: Providers that deliver meals to people at home.

title: Nursing care agencies
description: Agencies that provide nursing care at home or in facilities.

title: Personal care and in-home support providers
synonyms: personal care;home health aide;caregiver;personal care attendant
description: Aides and agencies that help people at home with bathing, dressing, meals and household tasks.

title: Community and support services
description: Community services coordinate care and support people with disabilities, children and families, and public health.

title: Case managers and care coordinators
description: Case managers and care coordinators help people get the health and social services they need.

title: Community health workers and educators
description: Community health workers, health educators and interpreters help people understand and reach care.

title: Developmental disability services
description: Day programs and services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

title: Early intervention providers
description: Services for babies and young children with developmental delays or disabilities.

title: Public health and social service agencies
description: Public health departments, charities, foster care agencies and school districts that provide health services.

title: Residential care and respite providers
description: Group homes and residential facilities for people with disabilities, and short-term respite care for caregivers.

title: Labs and technicians
description: Labs run medical tests on samples; technicians and technologists perform imaging, lab work and procedures.

title: Blood and organ banks
description: Blood banks and organ procurement organizations collect and supply blood and donated organs.

title: Clinical laboratories
description: Laboratories that run tests on blood, urine and tissue samples.

title: Imaging technologists
description: Radiologic technologists and sonographers perform X-rays, CT, MRI and ultrasound scans.

title: Lab technicians and phlebotomists
description: Lab technicians run medical tests; phlebotomists draw blood.

title: Surgical technologists and assistants
description: Surgical technologists, surgical assistants and perfusionists support surgeons in the operating room.

title: Other technicians and technologists
description: Other technicians and technologists, such as EEG and health information technicians.

title: Medical equipment and supply companies
description: Suppliers provide medical equipment and supplies for use at home, such as wheelchairs, oxygen, braces and nutrition products.

title: Durable medical equipment suppliers
description: Suppliers of medical equipment for the home, such as wheelchairs, hospital beds and walkers.

title: Emergency response system companies
description: Companies that provide medical alert devices for people living alone.

title: Nutrition supply companies
description: Suppliers of tube feeding, IV nutrition and medical foods.

title: Oxygen suppliers
description: Suppliers of home oxygen and breathing equipment.

title: Prosthetic and orthotic suppliers
description: Suppliers of artificial limbs, braces and supports.

title: Ambulance and transportation services
description: Ambulance services and transport companies take patients to and from care, in emergencies or for scheduled visits.

title: Ambulance services
description: Ambulance services transport patients by ground, air or water, in emergencies or between facilities.

title: EMTs and paramedics
description: Emergency medical technicians and paramedics give emergency care at the scene and on the way to the hospital.

title: Non-emergency medical transportation
description: Vans, cars and other rides to medical appointments for people who can't drive.

title: Transportation brokers
description: Companies that arrange medical rides for health plans and Medicaid.

title: Health plans
description: Health plans (HMOs, PPOs and similar organizations) arrange and pay for their members' care through a network of providers.

title: Health plans
description: Health plans (HMOs, PPOs and similar organizations) arrange and pay for their members' care.

title: Other providers
description: Other providers registered in NPPES, such as students in training, military providers and specialists in other fields.

title: Genetic counselors and geneticists
description: Genetic counselors explain inherited conditions and genetic test results to patients and families.

title: Medical groups
description: Group practices registered as a group.

title: Military health care providers
description: Independent duty corpsmen and medical technicians of the armed forces.

title: Students in training
description: Students in a health care education or training program.

title: Veterinarians
description: Veterinarians registered in NPPES, mostly for medical research.

title: Other providers
description: Providers registered in NPPES under other specialties.
